routing.reasoning: Ticket management system requires complex workflow with multiple branching paths (escalation, reopening, assignment), conditional logic, parallel notification processes, and state transitions. Multiple user roles with different form requirements necessitate advanced forms with role-based validation. Relational data with normalized schemas for tickets, users, assignments, and audit trails fits SQL model. Cross-platform mobile support needed for agents and customers. Sequential domain fits the step-by-step ticket lifecycle process.

routing.reasoning: Ticket management system requires complex workflow with multiple branching paths (escalation, reopening, assignment), conditional logic, parallel notification processes, and state transitions. Multiple user roles with different form requirements necessitate advanced forms with role-based validation. Relational data with normalized schemas for tickets, users, assignments, and audit trails fits SQL model. Cross-platform mobile support needed for agents and customers. Sequential domain fits the step-by-step ticket lifecycle process.

name: TicketLifecycleWorkflow
description: Manages the complete lifecycle of a support ticket from customer submission through assignment, resolution, customer confirmation, and final closure with notifications at each stage

data.label: Ticket Submitted
data.description: Customer submits a new support ticket

data.label: Validate Ticket Data
data.description: Validate ticket has required fields and proper category assignment

data.label: Auto-Categorize & Prioritize
data.description: Use AI to analyze ticket content, suggest category, and determine priority level

data.label: Manager Assignment
data.description: Manager reviews and assigns ticket to appropriate agent

data.label: Notify Agent & Customer
data.description: Send email notifications to assigned agent and customer about ticket assignment

data.label: Agent Work on Ticket
data.description: Agent investigates, updates status, adds comments, and works toward resolution

data.label: Resolution Ready?
data.description: Check if agent has marked ticket as resolved or needs more work

data.label: Notify Customer of Resolution
data.description: Send email to customer with resolution details and request confirmation

data.label: Customer Confirmation
data.description: Customer reviews resolution and confirms issue is resolved or requests reopening

data.label: Issue Resolved?
data.description: Check if customer confirmed resolution or requested ticket reopening

data.label: Close Ticket
data.description: Update ticket status to closed, log closure time, and archive ticket data

data.label: Send Closure Notification
data.description: Send final closure email to customer and agent with ticket summary

data.label: Ticket Closed
data.description: Ticket lifecycle complete

dataModels.name: Ticket
dataModels.description: Core entity representing support tickets with full lifecycle tracking including status, priority, assignment, and resolution details

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (New, Assigned, In Progress, Resolved, Closed, Reopened)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category or type of the ticket (Hardware, Software, Network, Access, Other)

fields.description: ID of the support agent assigned to the ticket

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: ID of the customer who submitted the ticket
